typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source slide 8 / title.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source slide 8 / bottom.

recognitionRules: Use Helvetica Neue and Avenir with a restrained blue product accent.
Lead with the customer’s job before feature detail.
Keep a visible rail beside the work artifact to explain the relevant decision.
Show request, hold and review as distinct states with explicit labels.

principles: Describe the user’s task and the visible next state with ordinary verbs.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: A session plan you can review before it becomes a promise.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid calling a concept a live service or implying unmeasured outcomes.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Choose the item, inspect the details and confirm the next step.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use SLOTLINE in Helvetica Neue with a thin horizontal slot cut into a supporting rectangular line, not through the letters. Avoid a calendar-check icon.
invariants: Use Helvetica Neue and Avenir with a restrained blue product accent.
Lead with the customer’s job before feature detail.
Keep a visible rail beside the work artifact to explain the relevant decision.
adaptations: A product card can show one request and its current state.
A launch story retains concept status until the product is real and tested.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Avenir Next is a separately licensed Apple/system font; not bundled.
Helvetica Neue is an Apple/system or separately licensed font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
